in_sanskrit.name: Arjman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror, Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arjman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arjman is a name of ancient Indian origin which is derived from the Sanskrit language. This name is popularly believed to be a variation of the name Arjuna, which is the name of the legendary warrior of the Mahabharata epic. The name Arjman is often given to children born in Hindu families as a mark of their belief in the power of courage, victory, and strength. It is a name that inspires confidence and determination, and is a powerful reminder of the indomitable spirit of the human soul.
